subject.title: fix(tools): surface empty availability group diagnostics via onHiddenDiagnostic callback

question: Should this PR be accepted as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92361 with warn-only preservation of plugin-authored availability-like metadata?
rationale: The code path is technically coherent, but overlapping candidate PRs and the compatibility-sensitive warning interpretation need maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Accept this warn-only path
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix after refresh and exact-head checks because it covers planner callback, plugin integration, and malformed metadata guards without filtering returned tools.

options.title: Choose a narrower sibling
options.body: Pick another open PR if maintainers want a smaller planner-only or descriptor-registration-only implementation, then close superseded candidates after one lands.

options.title: Request a stricter contract
options.body: Ask for a revised patch if malformed plugin availability should affect returned tool visibility rather than only warning.

recommendation.title: Accept this warn-only path
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix after refresh and exact-head checks because it covers planner callback, plugin integration, and malformed metadata guards without filtering returned tools.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice centers on the plugin descriptor-cache and plugin resolver behavior where the clearest current history signal is @steipete's descriptor-cache work.
